# Sai Vista Cultural Committee

> Community events and cultural celebrations at Sai Vista Society, Rahatani, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Public information is maintained by Sai Vista Cultural Committee. Updated 13 November 2026.

## Public pages
- [About the committee](https://saivistaculturalcommittee.in/about.html): Community information, location, resident access and contact details.
- [Sai Vista Marathon 2026](https://saivistaculturalcommittee.in/marathon-2026.html): 3 km and 5 km runs on 29 November 2026, reporting 5:45 AM IST at Sai Vista Multipurpose Court, Rahatani, PCMC. Registration closes at 200 submitted participants or 14 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST, whichever comes first. Current availability is checked in the registration form.
- [Marathon sponsorship](https://saivistaculturalcommittee.in/sponsorship.html): Financial and product-support enquiries for the community run. Contact Paresh on 8149525915.
- [Community portal](https://saivistaculturalcommittee.in/): Sign-in, registration and verified-resident services.

## Policies
- [Privacy](https://saivistaculturalcommittee.in/privacy.html): Data handling, sign-in and advertising information.
- [Terms](https://saivistaculturalcommittee.in/terms.html): Website and event-use terms.

## Contact
